name: Louis-Ernest Modea
original_name: ルイ=エルネスト・モデア
source: Louis-Ernest is the king of Modea. He has 1,001 wives in total and is often seen searching for the next person to become his 1,002nd wife.
translation: Louis-Ernest is the king of Modea. He has 1,001 wives in total and is often seen searching for the next person to become his 1,002nd wife.
